Following a consultation paper from Irdai proposing caps on distributor commissions, the stock price has plummeted. The market capitalisation fell from ₹87,290 crore to ₹45,174 crore over the past seven sessions. This decline represents a loss of over 48% during this period. The stock is back at its initial public offering price of ₹980.
